pairs.resume:
Junior Python developer.
- Built and documented REST APIs with Flask.
- Wrote SQL queries and migrations for a PostgreSQL side project.
- Used Git daily in a team of four.
- Containerised the app with Docker for deployment.
- Wrote unit tests for the API layer and fixed defects reported by support.
- Paired with two engineers on query tuning and database migrations.
- Automated a weekly export that saved the team two hours.
- Presented a short demo of the API to the product team.
Selected projects: helped migrate an internal service to a new host, wrote the runbook and handover notes, and stayed on call during the first release week. Earlier, I built a small command-line tool that cleaned duplicate customer records; the support team still uses it. Outside work, I volunteer with a local coding club and help beginners with their first projects. I also keep a small personal blog about process improvement and tools I am learning.
pairs.job_description: We are hiring a junior backend developer. Required: Python, SQL and REST APIs. You will work with Git and Flask. Docker experience is preferred. Kubernetes is not required for this role.

expected_excluded.reason: the posting explicitly says Kubernetes is not required

pairs.notes: PostgreSQL appears only in the resume, so it is resume evidence but not a job requirement.

pairs.resume: Frontend developer with React and TypeScript experience. Built responsive interfaces in HTML5 and CSS3, integrated REST APIs, and maintained a shared component library. Also wrote unit tests with Jest.
pairs.job_description: Frontend engineer needed. Experience with React or Angular is required, together with TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3 and REST APIs. You will build components and integrate APIs. You will work with designers and backend engineers, review pull requests and help shape our component standards. Storybook experience is a plus. This is a full-time role based in our Lahore office, with two remote days each week. We offer a learning budget, health cover and a yearly team offsite. Our interview process includes a short screening call and one team interview. We review applications every Monday.

evidence.CSS3: responsive interfaces in HTML5 and CSS3

pairs.notes: One alternative is evidenced, so the group is one satisfied requirement.

pairs.resume: Full stack developer. Built internal tools with Python and Flask, backed by PostgreSQL. Shipped React front ends that consume REST APIs. Familiar with AWS Lambda deployments.
pairs.job_description: Full stack developer with Python and Django or Flask experience. PostgreSQL and Docker are required. AWS is preferred. You will ship features across React and REST APIs. You will join a team of eight engineers, partner with product and design on requirements, write documentation for each service and support weekly releases. The role sits with the engineering manager and offers two remote days each week. Our hiring process includes a short screening call, a practical exercise and one team interview. We review applications every Monday and aim to reply within two weeks. We offer health cover, a yearly team offsite and two remote days each week. The office is close to public transport.

evidence.Django or Flask: built internal tools with Python and Flask

pairs.resume:
IT support specialist with Linux desktop administration experience. Handled password resets, hardware troubleshooting and user onboarding. Completed a short Git course. Supported 400 staff across three offices, documented repeat fixes and trained new starters on the ticketing system. Wrote scripts to automate account setup and kept an inventory of loan laptops.
Selected projects: coordinated a hardware refresh across two floors, kept the delivery checklist current and walked colleagues through the new sign-in process. I enjoy documenting repeat fixes so the next person has an easier time. References are available on request.
pairs.job_description: Senior DevOps engineer. Required: Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, CI/CD, Linux and Prometheus. Experience with Helm is a plus.
pairs.notes: Only Linux overlaps. Git is resume evidence but is not requested by the posting.

pairs.resume: QA engineer with four years of automation experience. Built Selenium suites, wrote unit tests with pytest and ran integration tests in CI. Used Postman for API checks and Cypress for end-to-end browser tests. Selected projects: introduced a smoke-test checklist for each release, reviewed failures with developers and kept a weekly quality summary for the team lead.
pairs.job_description: QA automation engineer. Required: Selenium, Cypress, Unit Testing, Integration Testing and Postman. You will maintain automated regression suites.
pairs.notes: All five requirements are explicitly evidenced.

Gained exposure to Snowflake during a warehouse migration. Selected projects: rebuilt a nightly load that had been timing out, documented the failure modes and handed the runbook to the platform team.
pairs.job_description: Data platform engineer. Required: Python, SQL, ETL and Snowflake. AWS experience is preferred. Airflow orchestration is a plus. You will join a team of six and work with product and commercial colleagues on the warehouse migration. This is a full-time role with two remote days each week and a yearly team offsite.

pairs.job_description: Machine learning engineer. Experience with Python or R programming is required. You will use Pandas, NumPy and Scikit-learn, and apply machine learning to production problems.

pairs.resume: Junior web developer. Built static pages with HTML and CSS. I react to feedback quickly and enjoy Excel at problem-solving. Looking for a first role in frontend development.
pairs.job_description: Junior web developer. Required: JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3 and React or Vue.js. Excel skills are a plus for reporting tasks. You will work with senior developers, attend planning sessions and fix small bugs across the site.
